plugins.name: specdd
plugins.description: Reusable Claude Code skills for SpecDD development workflows.

skills.name: specdd-adopt
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to add SpecDD to a project or update SpecDD framework files through the CLI before normal SpecDD work begins.
skills.description_zh: 在常规 SpecDD 工作前，通过 CLI 为项目加入 SpecDD 或更新框架文件。

skills.name: specdd-author
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to author or revise SpecDD `.sdd` specs in an existing SpecDD project.
skills.description_zh: 在已有 SpecDD 项目编写或修订 .sdd 规格。

skills.name: specdd-cli
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to use the `specdd` CLI for setup, updates, spec discovery, inspection, or linting.
skills.description_zh: 通过 specdd CLI 设置、更新、发现检查规格或执行 lint。

skills.name: specdd-debug
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to diagnose or fix a bug against active SpecDD specs.
skills.description_zh: 依据当前有效 SpecDD 规格诊断和修复缺陷。

skills.name: specdd-do
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to implement a code, docs, tests, task, or spec change under active SpecDD authority.
skills.description_zh: 在当前有效 SpecDD 规格约束下修改代码、文档、测试、任务或规格。

skills.name: specdd-docs
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to write or update documentation from active SpecDD specs.
skills.description_zh: 依据当前有效 SpecDD 规格编写或更新文档。

skills.name: specdd-explain
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to explain a SpecDD spec, target, behavior, or effective spec chain without editing it.
skills.description_zh: 只读解释 SpecDD 规格、目标、行为及实际生效的规格链。

skills.name: specdd-orient
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to get oriented in a SpecDD project before later work, while making no edits.
skills.description_zh: 只读了解 SpecDD 项目，为后续工作建立背景，不修改文件。

skills.name: specdd-plan
skills.description: Use when Claude Code is asked to plan SpecDD work or needs to resolve unclear scope, authority, risk, or verification before editing.
skills.description_zh: 规划 SpecDD 工作，在修改前澄清范围、权威依据、风险和验证要求。

skills.name: specdd-refactor
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to refactor code, tests, docs, specs, or project structure while preserving active SpecDD behavior.
skills.description_zh: 在保持当前 SpecDD 行为的前提下重构代码、测试、文档、规格或项目结构。

skills.name: specdd-review
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to review changes against active SpecDD specs.
skills.description_zh: 对照当前有效 SpecDD 规格评审变更。

skills.name: specdd-risk
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to classify risk before SpecDD work starts.
skills.description_zh: 在 SpecDD 工作开始前进行风险分类。

skills.name: specdd-task
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to find, add, interpret, organize, or update SpecDD `Tasks` entries.
skills.description_zh: 查找、添加、解释、组织和更新 SpecDD Tasks 条目。

skills.name: specdd-test
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to derive, add, update, or assess tests from active SpecDD specs.
skills.description_zh: 依据当前有效 SpecDD 规格推导、添加、更新或评估测试。

skills.name: specdd-trace
skills.description: Use when Claude Code needs to trace SpecDD specs to code, tests, docs, changed files, or coverage gaps.
skills.description_zh: 追踪 SpecDD 规格与代码、测试、文档、变更文件及覆盖缺口的关联。
